d9a54d1b: Initiates the check process for the presence of a discharge summary or the need to add one based on patient ID (DFN), date (DGJTDT), parameters (DGJPARM), IRT record ID (DGJIRTDA), division (DGJT), flag (DGJFLG), and type (DGJTYP).
e80b5266: Declare variable to hold flag for output.
aee77029: Retrieve parameters for the division from the hospital location file.
7d4752d2: Exit if parameters are not defined.
e0cd6ac8: Set default discharge summary type if not provided.
33897e25: If an IRT record exists and lacks a date, set flag to indicate an existing summary without a complete date.
5446a70f: Exit if an IRT record already exists.
7b552386: Iterate through IRT records for the patient until finding a match or flag is set.
993c1182: Set flag if discharge summary type and admission number match.
79eea9f6: If no IRT record is found, invoke the procedure to add a new record.
4fd1a771: Exit routine.
